preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 3000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and the maximum possible number of edges in a complete graph with n nodes inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and 0 <= w <= 10**5 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes within the range 1 to n and has a weight between 0 and 100,000 inclusive.
The starting node is within the range 1 to n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is the sum of the weights of the edges in the minimum spanning tree constructed using Prim's algorithm starting from the given start node.
